description: A script implementing a conversational bot with function calling capabilities, integrating speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and external services for weather, images, and restaurant recommendations, using Pipecat framework.

methods.name: get_weather
methods.description: Fetches weather information for a given location and sends it via callback.

methods.name: fetch_restaurant_recommendation
methods.description: Provides a restaurant recommendation and sends it via callback.

methods.name: get_image
methods.description: Requests an image from the user and pushes a frame upstream for analysis.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the main bot pipeline with transport and runner arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, creates transport and starts the bot process.
